metadata.description: German flood-warning intelligence skills powered by the hochwasserzentralen-cli (LHP-PublicAPI / hochwasserzentralen.de)

plugins.name: hochwasser
plugins.description: Check Germany's official flood warnings and the flood classification at ~1200 gauges, get a per-state situation overview, and export warning areas or gauges as GeoJSON — all over the open, key-free LHP-PublicAPI via the hochwasserzentralen-cli.
